---
name: {{name}}-run
description: Run a {{name}} role (planner, builder, reviewer, or any role in the project config) on an item, on the model that role is set to. Use when the user asks to run a role on an item ("run the builder on item 16", "plan item 16 with the planner").
---
<!-- {{name}}-managed: generated by `{{cmd}} sync`; edits are overwritten -->
1. Make sure the item's branch is checked out (`{{cmd}} status`; else `{{cmd}} open <id>`).
2. If this agent has a subagent named `{{name}}-<role>`, hand the step to it: tell it the item id
   and nothing else; it runs `{{cmd}} next` itself. Its run is logged automatically.
3. Otherwise run `{{cmd}} run <role> <id>`: it runs the role's agent and model headless and logs
   the run. Show the user its last lines.
4. Then run `{{cmd}} status` and say in one line what changed and what is next. Never approve or
   ship on a role's behalf: those stay the human's.
